$schema.description: Path to the JSON Schema file.

container_info_code.description: The infoCode to use for newly generated container DMs (S1000D specifies '914' for container modules).

use_config_info_code.description: If true, all generated container DMs use 'container_info_code' (with infoCodeVariant 'A') and group all non-excluded DMs sharing the same SNS, disassemblyCode, itemLocationCode, and language into a single container. If false, DMs are grouped separately by their original infoCode and infoCodeVariant, which the container inherits.

container_default_dcv.description: The default disassemblyCodeVariant to use for the container DM.

container_default_sdc.description: The default systemDiffCode to use for the container DM.

create_container_for_single_dms.description: If true, a container will be created even for single-member groups.

create_referenced_applic_group.description: If true, generates a <referencedApplicGroup> in the content section of the container with cross-referenced applicability statements for each member.

excluded_info_codes.description: A list of exact 3-character infoCode strings (case-insensitive, e.g., '000', '00W') to exclude from container grouping.

override_rpc_enterprise_code.description: If set to a string, overrides the enterpriseCode attribute on <responsiblePartnerCompany> in new containers. If null, retains the enterpriseCode from the primary (alphabetically first) grouped DM.

override_originator_enterprise_code.description: If set to a string, overrides the enterpriseCode attribute on <originator> in new containers. If null, retains the enterpriseCode from the primary (alphabetically first) grouped DM.

container_issue_number.description: A fixed issue number for all new containers.

container_inwork_number.description: A fixed inWork number for all new containers.

container_issue_year.description: A fixed year for the issue date of new containers.

container_issue_month.description: A fixed month for the issue date of new containers.

container_issue_day.description: A fixed day for the issue date of new containers.

use_fixed_reason_for_update.description: If true, replaces any <reasonForUpdate> elements in new containers with a single <reasonForUpdate> containing 'fixed_reason_for_update_text'. If false, retains existing <reasonForUpdate> elements from the primary grouped DM.

fixed_reason_for_update_text.default: Container data module automatically generated to group variants.
fixed_reason_for_update_text.description: The fixed text to insert into <reasonForUpdate>.

remove_issue_info_from_content_refs.description: If true, removes <issueInfo> from <dmRefIdent> and <pmRefIdent> in the content section of all processed modules to satisfy BRDP-S1-00573 and project BREX rules.

remove_language_from_content_refs.description: If true, removes <language> from <dmRefIdent> in the content section of all processed modules to satisfy project BREX rules.

remove_ident_extension_from_content_refs.description: If true, removes <identExtension> from <dmRefIdent> in the content section of all processed modules to satisfy project BREX rules.

remove_applic_ref_id_from_content_refs.description: If true, strips the 'applicRefId' attribute from <dmRef> elements in the content section to satisfy project BREX rules. Automatically disables 'create_referenced_applic_group'.

generate_applic_display_text.description: If true, generates human-readable display text within <applic> to satisfy BRDP-S1-00547.
